description.en: Given a non-negative integer n, calculate its factorial using recursion. The factorial of n (written as n!) is the product of all positive integers from 1 to n. By definition, 0! = 1.
description.hi: Ek non-negative integer n diya hai, recursion use karke uska factorial nikalo. n ka factorial (n! likha jaata hai) 1 se n tak ke saare positive integers ka product hota hai. Definition se, 0! = 1.

hints.en: Base case: factorial(0) = 1
hints.hi: Base case: factorial(0) = 1

hints.en: Recursive case: factorial(n) = n * factorial(n-1)
hints.hi: Recursive case: factorial(n) = n * factorial(n-1)

description.en: Given a non-negative integer n, find the nth Fibonacci number using recursion. The Fibonacci sequence is: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ... where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones. F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1.
description.hi: Ek non-negative integer n diya hai, recursion use karke nth Fibonacci number nikalo. Fibonacci sequence hai: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ... jisme har number pichle do numbers ka sum hota hai. F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1.

hints.en: Base cases: F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1
hints.hi: Base cases: F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1

hints.en: Recursive case: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)
hints.hi: Recursive case: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)

approach.en: Use recursion with two base cases: F(0)=0, F(1)=1. Return F(n-1) + F(n-2) for n >= 2.
approach.hi: Do base cases ke saath recursion use karo: F(0)=0, F(1)=1. n >= 2 ke liye F(n-1) + F(n-2) return karo.

description.en: Given a non-negative integer n, find the sum of its digits using recursion. For example, for n = 1234, the sum is 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10.
description.hi: Ek non-negative integer n diya hai, recursion use karke uske digits ka sum nikalo. Jaise n = 1234 ke liye, sum hai 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10.

hints.en: Last digit = n % 10, remaining number = n / 10
hints.hi: Last digit = n % 10, baaki number = n / 10

hints.en: Base case: when n is 0, return 0
hints.hi: Base case: jab n 0 ho, 0 return karo

description.en: Given two integers x and n (n >= 0), calculate x raised to the power n (x^n) using recursion. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
description.hi: Do integers x aur n (n >= 0) diye hain, recursion use karke x ki power n (x^n) nikalo. Result modulo 10^9 + 7 return karo.

hints.en: Base case: x^0 = 1
hints.hi: Base case: x^0 = 1

problems.title: Print All Subsequences

description.en: Given a string s, print all possible subsequences of the string. A subsequence is a sequence that can be derived from the string by deleting some or no characters without changing the order of remaining characters. Print each subsequence on a new line in lexicographic order. Print an empty line for the empty subsequence.
description.hi: Ek string s diya hai, uski saari possible subsequences print karo. Subsequence ek aisi sequence hai jo string se kuch characters delete karke banayi ja sakti hai bina order change kiye. Har subsequence nayi line pe lexicographic order mein print karo. Empty subsequence ke liye empty line print karo.

examples.output:
a
ab
abc
ac
b
bc
c

explanation.en: All 2^3 = 8 subsequences of 'abc' including the empty one
explanation.hi: 'abc' ki saari 2^3 = 8 subsequences including empty wali

constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters

hints.en: For each character, you have two choices: include it or exclude it
hints.hi: Har character ke liye do choices hain: include karo ya exclude karo

hints.en: Use a temporary string to build the current subsequence
hints.hi: Current subsequence build karne ke liye ek temporary string use karo

starterCode.python:

s = input()
result = []

approach.en: Use include/exclude pattern at each index. At base case (idx == length), add current string to result.
approach.hi: Har index pe include/exclude pattern use karo. Base case (idx == length) pe current string result mein add karo.

description.en: Given n pairs of parentheses, generate all combinations of well-formed (valid) parentheses. Print each combination on a new line in lexicographic order.
description.hi: n pairs parentheses diye hain, saari valid (well-formed) parentheses combinations generate karo. Har combination nayi line pe lexicographic order mein print karo.

explanation.en: All 5 valid combinations of 3 pairs of parentheses
explanation.hi: 3 pairs parentheses ki saari 5 valid combinations

explanation.en: Only one valid combination for 1 pair
explanation.hi: 1 pair ke liye sirf ek valid combination

hints.en: Track count of open and close brackets used
hints.hi: Open aur close brackets ka count track karo

hints.en: Add '(' if open count < n, add ')' if close count < open count
hints.hi: '(' tab add karo jab open count < n ho, ')' tab add karo jab close count < open count ho

starterCode.python:

problems.title: Permutations of String

description.en: Given a string s with distinct characters, print all permutations of the string. Print each permutation on a new line in lexicographic order.
description.hi: Ek string s diya hai jisme saare characters alag hain, string ke saare permutations print karo. Har permutation nayi line pe lexicographic order mein print karo.

examples.output:
abc
acb
bac
bca
cab
cba

explanation.en: All 3! = 6 permutations of 'abc' in sorted order
explanation.hi: 'abc' ke saare 3! = 6 permutations sorted order mein

constraints: All characters in s are distinct lowercase English letters

hints.en: Fix one character at a time and recurse for the rest
hints.hi: Ek character fix karo aur baaki ke liye recurse karo

hints.en: Swap current index with every index from current to end
hints.hi: Current index ko current se end tak har index ke saath swap karo

starterCode.python:
def permute(s, idx, result):
    # Write your code here
    pass

s = list(input())
result = []
permute(s, 0, result)
result.sort()
for p in result:

testCases.expectedOutput:
abc
acb
bac
bca
cab
cba

approach.en: Swap each character to the current position, recurse, then swap back (backtrack). Sort results for lexicographic order.
approach.hi: Har character ko current position pe swap karo, recurse karo, phir wapas swap karo (backtrack). Lexicographic order ke liye results sort karo.

description.hi: Ek array diya hai positive integers ka aur ek target sum diya hai, check karo ki array ka koi aisa subset hai jiske elements ka sum target ke barabar ho. Agar aisa subset hai to 'true' print karo, nahi to 'false' print karo.

hints.en: For each element, you either include it in the subset or not

hints.en: If including current element, reduce target by that element's value
hints.hi: Agar current element include kiya, to target ko us element ki value se reduce karo

problems.title: Sudoku Solver

description.en: Given a partially filled 9x9 Sudoku grid, solve it using backtracking. Fill the empty cells (represented by 0) such that every row, column, and 3x3 sub-box contains digits 1-9 exactly once. Print the solved grid, with each row on a new line and numbers separated by spaces.
description.hi: Ek partially filled 9x9 Sudoku grid diya hai, backtracking use karke solve karo. Empty cells (0 se represented) ko aise bharo ki har row, column, aur 3x3 sub-box mein digits 1-9 exactly ek baar aayein. Solved grid print karo, har row nayi line pe aur numbers space se separated.

explanation.en: Each row, column, and 3x3 box has digits 1-9 exactly once
explanation.hi: Har row, column, aur 3x3 box mein digits 1-9 exactly ek baar hain

constraints: A valid solution always exists for the given input

hints.en: Find an empty cell, try digits 1-9, check validity, recurse
hints.hi: Empty cell dhundho, digits 1-9 try karo, validity check karo, recurse karo

hints.en: To check validity: ensure digit is not in same row, column, or 3x3 box
hints.hi: Validity check karne ke liye: digit same row, column, ya 3x3 box mein nahi hona chahiye

hints.en: If no digit works for a cell, backtrack to previous cell
hints.hi: Agar koi digit kisi cell ke liye kaam nahi karta, previous cell pe backtrack karo

approach.en: Find empty cell, try 1-9, validate against row/column/3x3 box, recurse. If no digit works, backtrack by resetting cell to 0.
approach.hi: Empty cell dhundho, 1-9 try karo, row/column/3x3 box ke against validate karo, recurse karo. Agar koi digit kaam na kare, cell ko 0 karke backtrack karo.
